BiblicalUsage: The word is the Aramaic for a decree, an authoritative word: the matter is by the decree of the watchers, says Daniel, and Ezra is given whatever he needs by the king's decree.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the decree of the watchers is higher than the decree of any king: Nebuchadnezzar learned that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and His decree stands when every other falls.
